# Original Identity V Persona UI resources

These images belong to Identity V / NetEase and their respective rights holders. They are used under the collaboration authorization stated by the site owner.

The source is the previously inspected official Android UI package cached in `work/3d-research/room/apk-inspection/ui2.wpk` / `ui3.wpk`, with `ui.idx` and `ui.thy`. The supplied PC installation was no longer present at `D:/FeverApps/dwrg2` during this revision, so no claim is made that these pixels came from that PC installation. The original data paths are `ui/dm65ui/res/system/note_persona/…`. Content was read as data only; no game scripts or executables were run.

ASTC and BC3/PVR containers are decoded into PNG and cropped only by the original container dimensions when present. No generative replacement, repainting or artificial enlargement is included. Source pixel dimensions are retained: stage background 667×375, centre ink 270×250, grid 223×223, node discs 124×124, selection discs 136×136, and four persona emblems 60×60. Nodes are displayed below their source size. The original background is intentionally soft; it is not labelled a high-resolution photograph.

The corresponding source MD5, data path and pixel dimensions are in `manifest.json`. Those MD5 values were checked against the original path index before decoding.

The website adapts the original Persona page into a four-direction course diagram. Course text, the four subject groups, completed/current/planned semantics, CSS gold treatment, selection details, pagination and accessible keyboard behavior are website additions. Lines represent visual grouping, not university prerequisites. No game talent point total, skill effect or completion claim beyond the user's handwritten course record is shown.

Visual references inspected on 23 October 2026:

- Original 2018 Persona page screenshot: https://img.18183.com/uploads/allimg/180402/91-1P402154138.jpg
- 2019 Persona page screenshot: https://truth.bahamut.com.tw/s01/201906/fa38ead532664f971049e6abb6b0efea.JPG
- Original Persona system changes from the publisher: https://www.identityvgame.com/jp/news/update/20250619/35356_1241769.html

Course names are the 2026 UNSW Handbook titles; each course in `../../data/course-catalog.json` links directly to its verified official Handbook page. Study status is supplied by the owner, not inferred from the Handbook.
